title: As Gen Z reconsiders dating apps, Tinder's IRL events expand to dozens more cities | TechCrunch
summary: In March, Tinder introduced in-person events, starting in Los Angeles, that are featured in a dedicated Events tab in Tinder’s mobile app. Now, Tinder is expanding its events efforts beyond LA’s initial beta test.
